periods.analysis: Thirty-eight parents took part in the first Family Home Visiting small-group series.
periods.recommendations: Run a second series in the spring.

periods.analysis: Participation rose from 38 to 52 parents with the second small-group series.
periods.recommendations: Recruit Riverside parents early for summer groups, since travel season can thin sign-ups.

periods.analysis: Participation reached 61 in Q3, but the 17% rise is slower than the earlier increase from 38 to 52. Two Riverside parents' groups were canceled because of low sign-ups during the summer travel season.
periods.recommendations: Move groups to evenings and add child care to improve attendance in Q4.
